title: Mesh Garden Apron – Breathable with Pockets
descriptionHtml:
Keep your tools close – and your clothes clean

Running in and out for the pruning shears, the gloves and the seed packets takes both time and patience. And regular aprons get hot and sweaty as soon as the sun comes out.

Cool, tough and full of pockets

This garden apron in breathable mesh keeps you cool even on hot days, while protecting your clothes from soil and stains. The roomy pockets keep tools, seeds and your phone within reach so you don't have to run back and forth.

Features

  • Breathable mesh that keeps you cool
  • Several roomy pockets for tools and accessories
  • Adjustable straps that fit most people
  • Protects your clothes from soil, water and stains
  • Suits gardening, woodworking and crafts

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
